explanation: Floor division omits the final partial page, so totals not divisible by size report too few pages. Use ceiling division while preserving zero pages for an empty collection.
Non-positive page numbers are accepted and become negative slice offsets, returning unrelated items instead of enforcing one-based pagination. Reject page values below one.
A non-positive size is not rejected by page_items; zero or negative values produce empty or misleading slices. Validate size and raise ValueError as page_count does.
